_comment: Resident traits and job mastery. Typed in src/sim/systems/traits.ts; see docs/design/M6-spec.md. Effect kinds: production (fraction, optional resources/categories/when), happiness (points, optional categories/when), roomHappiness (points to everyone else in the same room), combat (fraction), damageTaken (fraction, quests), critRing (fraction of ring speed, quests), explorerScrip (fraction), explorerTaint (fraction removed), explorerCheck and questCheck (flat points), xp (fraction), mastery (fraction of accrual rate; mastery is job experience in seconds: one per second worked plus masteryPerCollect per batch collected), courtship (fraction of courtship speed). Conditions (when): deep, topside, crowd (2+ others in the room), fewOthers (at most 1 other), alone, night, morning, experienced (Journeyman or better in this room type), novice (Apprentice in a room with a stat).

traits.name: Root Talker
traits.description: Talks to the lettuce every morning. The lettuce has never once complained.
traits.summary: +12% output in food rooms.

traits.name: Spark Chaser
traits.description: Has been shocked eleven times and speaks fondly of each one.
traits.summary: +12% output in power rooms.

traits.name: Dowser
traits.description: Can hear water moving in the pipes. Can also hear it in the walls, which is less reassuring.
traits.summary: +12% output in water rooms.

traits.name: Bedside Manner
traits.description: Says "this won't hurt a bit" and somehow you believe it, every time.
traits.summary: +12% output in Med-Patch and Purge rooms.

traits.name: Egghead
traits.description: Reads the Halcyon service manuals for pleasure. Footnotes included.
traits.summary: +12% output in Labs; −10% damage in fights.

traits.name: Tinkerer
traits.description: Owns a screwdriver for every screw, and a few for screws nobody has invented yet.
traits.summary: +12% crafting speed; +5 happiness in workshops.

traits.name: Night Owl
traits.description: Does their best work after lights-out, when the hum of the homestead drops half a key.
traits.summary: +15% output on the night shift (20:00–04:00).

traits.name: Early Bird
traits.description: Up before the klaxon. Has opinions about people who aren't.
traits.summary: +15% output on the morning shift (04:00–12:00).

traits.name: Social Butterfly
traits.description: Knows everyone's name, birthday and blood type, in that order.
traits.summary: +10 happiness in a busy room; −10 working alone.

traits.name: Loner
traits.description: Prefers the company of a turbine. Turbines don't ask how your weekend was.
traits.summary: +10 happiness and +8% output with at most one coworker; −10 happiness in a crowd.

traits.name: Claustrophobic
traits.description: Knows exactly how much rock is overhead at all times, and would rather not.
traits.summary: −20 happiness on deep floors; +5 near the surface.

traits.name: Deep Delver
traits.description: Finds the lower strata cosy. Has asked twice whether we could go further down.
traits.summary: +12% output and +10 happiness on deep floors.

traits.name: Hothead
traits.description: Wins every argument, mostly on volume.
traits.summary: +15% damage in fights; −5 happiness, and −3 to everyone in the same room.

traits.name: Sunny Disposition
traits.description: Believes the Glare is just a very enthusiastic sunrise.
traits.summary: +10 happiness, and +5 to everyone in the same room.

traits.name: Grump
traits.description: Works quickly so the conversation ends sooner.
traits.summary: +10% output; −5 happiness, and −3 to everyone in the same room.

traits.name: Lazybones
traits.description: Considers the break room less a place than a calling.
traits.summary: −10% output; +10 happiness.

traits.name: Romantic
traits.description: Keeps a scrapbook of other people's weddings. Has pressed a flower from each.
traits.summary: Courtship 30% faster; +10 happiness in living quarters.

traits.name: Quick Study
traits.description: Read the manual once, upside down, and still passed the test.
traits.summary: +15% XP; mastery builds 25% faster.

traits.name: Creature of Habit
traits.description: Same chair, same mug, same seven-minute lunch since the day the door first opened.
traits.summary: +10 happiness in a job they're Journeyman or better at; −5 as an Apprentice.

traits.name: Restless
traits.description: Has reorganised the storeroom three times this month. Nobody asked.
traits.summary: Mastery builds 30% slower; +10% output while still an Apprentice.

traits.name: Glare-Hardened
traits.description: Got a tan in the Glarelands once and simply kept it.
traits.summary: −30% taint while exploring.

traits.name: Loose Change
traits.description: Finds scrip in couch cushions, and finds couches in the Glarelands.
traits.summary: +20% scrip found while exploring.

traits.name: Lucky Break
traits.description: Has survived three falls, two cave-ins and a Tuesday. Doesn't like to talk about the Tuesday.
traits.summary: +2 on exploration checks; +1 on quest event checks.

traits.name: Steady Hands
traits.description: Could thread a needle during a Mauler charge. Has, in fact.
traits.summary: The crit ring sweeps 15% slower on quests.

traits.name: Hard Case
traits.description: Took a Skitter bite to the arm and asked if it was finished.
traits.summary: −12% damage taken on quests.

_legendaryTraitsComment: M9 (stream L): signature traits of the legendary residents (legends.json), never rolled or inherited. Each legend starts with one; its _awakened version replaces it when their personal questline is done.

legendaryTraits.name: Switchback
legendaryTraits.description: Never takes the same road twice, which is how she keeps finding new things on it.
legendaryTraits.summary: +30% scrip found exploring, +3 to exploration checks.

legendaryTraits.name: Every Road Home
legendaryTraits.description: Found the one road she never took. It went home. She is taking it anyway, the long way.
legendaryTraits.summary: +45% scrip found exploring, +5 to exploration checks, shrugs off 25% of taint.

legendaryTraits.name: Guildmaster's Eye
legendaryTraits.description: Can tell a good weld from across the room, and will tell you about a bad one from further.
legendaryTraits.summary: +30% crafting speed in workshops, +25% mastery gain.

legendaryTraits.name: Master of the Guild
legendaryTraits.description: Reinstated, with apologies, by a guild that finally read the minutes.
legendaryTraits.summary: +45% crafting speed in workshops, +50% mastery gain, +4 happiness to workshop mates.

legendaryTraits.name: Cold Start
legendaryTraits.description: Learned to think in a homestead where nobody thought about him. It made him very good at it.
legendaryTraits.summary: +30% research in labs, +2 to quest checks.

legendaryTraits.name: Warm Start
legendaryTraits.description: Has a name, a birthday and a homestead now. He is still very good at thinking. He is also happy.
legendaryTraits.summary: +45% research in labs, +3 to quest checks, +10 happiness.

legendaryTraits.name: Longest Shift
legendaryTraits.description: Has been on call for two hundred years. His bedside manner has held up better than he has.
legendaryTraits.summary: +35% Med-Patch and Purge output, +5 happiness to roommates.

legendaryTraits.name: Clocked Out
legendaryTraits.description: Finally handed over his shift. He came back the next morning anyway, rested and slightly insufferable.
legendaryTraits.summary: +50% Med-Patch and Purge output, +8 happiness to roommates.

legendaryTraits.name: House Edge
legendaryTraits.description: Believes the odds are a suggestion. So far, the odds agree.
legendaryTraits.summary: Crit ring 30% slower (easier), +20% scrip found exploring, +2 to quest checks.

legendaryTraits.name: The House Always Wins
legendaryTraits.description: Won the last game worth winning. He is now, formally, the house.
legendaryTraits.summary: Crit ring 45% slower (easier), +35% scrip found exploring, +3 to quest checks.

legendaryTraits.name: Deep-Born
legendaryTraits.description: Grew up where the pipes hum. Up here it is too quiet to think.
legendaryTraits.summary: +30% output and +15 happiness on deep floors, shrugs off 30% of exploration taint.

legendaryTraits.name: Keeper of Four
legendaryTraits.description: The pipes on Four answer to her now. HALCY has stopped asking how.
legendaryTraits.summary: +45% output and +20 happiness on deep floors, shrugs off 50% of exploration taint.

legendaryTraits.name: Ring Champion
legendaryTraits.description: Fought in the Rustman ring for eleven years. Lost once. Was very gracious about it, eventually.
legendaryTraits.summary: +30% damage in fights, 15% less damage taken on quests.

legendaryTraits.name: Champion of Two Rings
legendaryTraits.description: Champion of the clans and of the homestead. He wears both belts. They clash.
legendaryTraits.summary: +45% damage in fights, 25% less damage taken on quests.

legendaryTraits.name: Seen Worse
legendaryTraits.description: Whatever it is, she has seen worse, and she will tell you about it while it happens.
legendaryTraits.summary: Shrugs off 50% of exploration taint, +6 happiness to roommates, 10% less damage taken on quests.

legendaryTraits.name: Seen It All
legendaryTraits.description: Has now, finally, seen everything. She says most of it was overrated.
legendaryTraits.summary: Shrugs off 75% of exploration taint, +10 happiness to roommates, 15% less damage taken on quests.

legendaryTraits.name: Lapsed Liturgy
legendaryTraits.description: Kept the sermons, lost the doctrine. Attendance has never been better.
legendaryTraits.summary: +8 happiness to roommates, +10 happiness of his own, +30% courtship speed.

legendaryTraits.name: A Light of His Own
legendaryTraits.description: Lit his lamp at last, for a reason of his own. He will not say what. It burns very steadily.
legendaryTraits.summary: +12 happiness to roommates, +15 happiness of his own, +50% courtship speed.

legendaryTraits.name: Holds Her Breath
legendaryTraits.description: Can go four minutes without air, and considerably longer without small talk.
legendaryTraits.summary: +30% output in water rooms, +2 to exploration checks.

legendaryTraits.name: Deep End
legendaryTraits.description: Dived the bottom of the Stillwater and came back up. She says the city said goodbye.
legendaryTraits.summary: +45% output in water rooms, +4 to exploration checks, shrugs off 25% of taint.

legendaryTraits.name: Standing Orders
legendaryTraits.description: Her last orders were to hold the line. Nobody ever told her where the line ended.
legendaryTraits.summary: +25% damage in fights, 20% less damage taken on quests, +2 to quest checks.

legendaryTraits.name: New Orders
legendaryTraits.description: Wrote her own orders for the first time. They are short, and mostly about us.
legendaryTraits.summary: +40% damage in fights, 30% less damage taken on quests, +3 to quest checks.

achievements.name: Learning the Ropes
achievements.description: Have a resident make Journeyman in any job.

achievements.name: Master Class
achievements.description: Have a resident make Master in any job.

achievements.name: Renaissance Resident
achievements.description: Have one resident make Master in three different jobs.

achievements.name: Colourful Characters
achievements.description: Have 20 different traits among your residents at once.

achievements.name: Chip Off the Old Block
achievements.description: Pass 10 traits from parents to their children.
